svg.aria-label: A trace and a Signal's prompt and schema go into the Signals agent, which outputs a signal event. In the trace, a user says picture messages won't send; the support agent looks up the account, calls transfer_to_human_agents saying its tools are unavailable, and tells the user they are being transferred. The prompt asks 'Did the agent decline to do all or part of what the user asked?', with a schema of declined_part and reason_given. The Signals agent greps the trace for 'transfer', reads the transfer_to_human_agents span, and submits an event: declined_part 'MMS troubleshooting', reason_given 'capability', severity warning.
